title: AI Alps
tagline: A chrome machine crashes a Courchevel ski party at midnight. It will pay 10,000 GM for one name.
blurb: It walked down out of the trees at midnight, looking for a boy. Lucien Vasseur owns the mountain and sells every name on it, and his price is 10,000 GM. So the machine takes it out of his party: punches only, no jumping, no dodging, and every bottle, glass and ice bucket on the bars is a weapon. Guests turn on it, then the door staff, the ski patrol and Vasseur's own guard, with a scene every 1,500 GM as the stakes rise. Névé keeps the Funky House playing from the booth.

meta.controls: W A S D or the arrow keys: move. Shift: run. J, F or a click: punch (jab, cross, hook, body shot, uppercut; hold: a haymaker). Blows from in front land on his forearms. Drag: look around. P: pause. On touch screens, a stick and buttons.
